brief:
Amid displacement across Gaza, pet cats have become a crucial source of emotional support for children, Eye on Palestine reported. The animals provide solace as families cope with the upheaval of being forced from their homes and communities.

For displaced children in Gaza, pets serve as a bridge to stability during the crisis, offering companionship as families navigate their new circumstances.
dek: Amid the harsh realities of displacement in Gaza, pet children cats have become a vital source of emotional comfort for children.
title: Gaza children find emotional comfort in pet cats amid displacement
